note: Value-oracle cases for the pure, JSON-encodable functions of honest-persist whose exact output the declaration fixes. honest-persist returns BARE unions (value | Fault), never an {ok}/{err} envelope, so a success expected is the bare value and a fault is recognized by its shape in laws_hp.py. These cases are latent oracles: value-check.py runs each one the moment its function is built and exported, so the six already-built functions (engine_of, worth_retrying, budget_spent, migration_needed, schema_from_declared, field) prove green today and the rest activate as the code port lands. The live RED signal for all 87 functions is laws_hp.py. Functions whose exact serialization the declaration does not fix (SQL text, inspection statements, retry backoff) carry a property law in laws_hp.py instead of a value case, and are named in value_oracle_exempt.

value_oracle_exempt.reason: A RetryStep whose delay is a backoff the declaration leaves to next_wait, not a value the declaration fixes, so a full-equality value case cannot pin it. Each of the four dispositions (landed, run, give_up_contention, give_up_logical) and the budget-exhaustion sequence are driven and asserted by _probe_retry_schedule in laws_hp.py.

A backoff progression the declaration describes as zero on the first attempt and rising after, without fixing the exact seconds, so the exact later values are not a value the declaration pins. Its first-attempt-zero, non-negativity and strict rise are asserted by _probe_next_wait in laws_hp.py.

The exact SQL text one engine writes is not fixed by the declaration, so a value case cannot pin it without inventing SQL. Its totality (a valid declaration yields a Statement {text, parameters}) and its NoMatch on an unknown asking word are asserted by _probe_query_pure in laws_hp.py.
Engine DDL text is not fixed by the declaration. Shape and the create_view NoMatch pass-through are asserted by _probe_engine_tables in laws_hp.py.
SELECT text is not fixed by the declaration. Shape and the compile_statement NoMatch pass-through are asserted by _probe_engine_tables in laws_hp.py.
The six per-engine inspection statements are engine SQL the declaration does not fix. The Inspecting shape (six statements plus the types map) is asserted by _probe_engine_tables in laws_hp.py.

The exact per-engine comparison symbols are engine SQL the declaration does not fix; its two NoMatch misses (unknown engine, unknown operator) are the declared behaviour and are asserted by _probe_query_pure in laws_hp.py.
The transaction preamble is engine SQL the declaration does not fix; the Transacting shape is asserted by _probe_engine_tables in laws_hp.py.
The per-engine retryable set and bound are operational numbers the declaration does not fix as values; the RetryPolicy shape is asserted by _probe_engine_tables in laws_hp.py.
The per-engine rollback mode is one of a two-word vocabulary the declaration does not fix per engine; membership is asserted by _probe_engine_tables in laws_hp.py.
The per-engine spelling of a change is engine SQL the declaration does not fix; the Spelling shape is asserted by _probe_engine_tables in laws_hp.py.
Which of the seven carry-flags a kind fills is a table the declaration leaves to the implementation; the Carrying shape is asserted by _probe_engine_tables in laws_hp.py.
What each engine does natively is an engine fact the declaration does not fix per pair; the Capability shape is asserted by _probe_engine_tables in laws_hp.py.
The per-grammar method names carry a fold through a real parse the declaration does not fix; the MethodNames shape is asserted by _probe_query_pure in laws_hp.py.

The Condition nesting is complex and partly engine-free the declaration does not fix as one value; its bare-value eq, the operators NoMatch, and the wrong-count Fault are asserted by _probe_query_pure in laws_hp.py.
The operations that build a freshness are engine mechanisms the declaration does not fix; shape is asserted by _probe_refresh in laws_hp.py.
A Disposition built from worth_retrying and budget_spent; its continue/stop answers and its never-retry_after rule are asserted by _probe_refresh in laws_hp.py.
